news.raw_snippet: Artificial intelligence startup Generalist AI Inc., a startup building embodied robotics intelligence, said today it has raised $400 million in new funding, bringing the company’s valuation to $2 billion. Generalist AI’s most recent contribution to that industry is GEN-1, released in April, a highly capable AI foundation model for robot learning showing mastery of physical tasks. Physical AI is the layer of artificial intelligence that operates and interacts with the physical world by combining AI models with sensors, actuators and control systems. GEN-1 embodies a trend that is rapidly growing in robotics, the ability to translate physical human skills from the real world into robotic arms and other appendages and do them with speed and intelligence.

news.title: AI公司加速迈向华尔街大型首发
news.snippet: 从Anthropic到SpaceX再到OpenAI，科技巨头们正筹备进行大规模的华尔街IPO。
news.raw_snippet: From Anthropic to SpaceX to OpenAI, tech giants are looking to take their shares public to access more capital in the race to shape the technology's future. The amount of money involved in building and maintaining artificial intelligence models, the pursuit of artificial general intelligence that can surpass humans at many tasks, and widespread AI adoption all have led to an air of excitement around the technology that has helped lift the stock market to record highs. Here's a look at some of the biggest AI-focused companies. ### SpaceX's IPO is set to be the biggest ever and could make Elon Musk a trillionaire. Elon Musk’s SpaceX was valued at $800 billion last year, but its value grew to $1.25 trillion after the space exploration company merged in February with Musk’s artificial intelligence company, xAI. The San Francisco-based company is moving toward going public on Wall Street, announcing June 1 that it has submitted a confidential filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed IPO.

news.snippet: 卡内基投资顾问博客分析了SpaceX、OpenAI和Anthropic即将进行的IPO对投资者的意义。
news.raw_snippet: ## Carnegie Investment Counsel Blog. What Investors Should Know About the SpaceX, OpenAI, and Anthropic IPOs. There are multiple mega-cap companies planning an initial public offering (“IPO”) during the remainder of 2026. The company is targeting to raise more than $75 billion at a valuation of about $2 trillion. Anthropic’s most recent valuation was $965 billion, and OpenAI’s was $830 billion. These valuations would place SpaceX as one of the ten largest public companies in the world, with Anthropic and OpenAI not far behind. SpaceX’s first-quarter revenue grew 15% year over year to $4.7 billion, with most of that revenue coming from Starlink, which provides broadband connectivity through a constellation of low-Earth orbit satellites to customers in remote and underserved areas globally. Over the long term, the true value of these companies will be revealed as investors are given more time to evaluate the underlying stories, the real growth potential, and more shares are available to trade.

news.title: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky计划创办新AI公司
news.snippet: Airbnb首席执行官Brian Chesky宣布计划创立一家人工智能新公司，拓展业务版图。
news.raw_snippet: # Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky plans to start a new AI company. Brian Chesky co-founded Airbnb nearly 20 years ago after studying design in college. Airbnb Inc. Chief Executive Officer Brian Chesky is starting a new artificial intelligence lab, according to several people familiar with the matter, marking his first foray into the global AI race. Chesky plans to create an AI venture to develop artificial intelligence models and is considering a focus on user interaction and design, said the people, who spoke on condition of anonymity as the information is not public. He is in the early stages of funding the lab, one person said, and the details could change. He will not serve as chief executive of the new lab, one person said. As a rare founder-CEO of a Fortune 500 company, Chesky has been deeply involved in setting the product and business vision of Airbnb.
